question: List the first 10 artists alphabetically.
expected_sql: SELECT Name FROM Artist ORDER BY Name LIMIT 10

question: List three artists alphabetically.
expected_sql: SELECT Name FROM Artist ORDER BY Name LIMIT 3

question: How many artists are there?
expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS ArtistCount FROM Artist

question: How many albums are there?
expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS AlbumCount FROM Album

question: How many tracks are there?
expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS TrackCount FROM Track

question: List the five most expensive tracks.
expected_sql: SELECT Name, UnitPrice FROM Track ORDER BY UnitPrice DESC, Name LIMIT 5

question: List the five cheapest tracks.
expected_sql: SELECT Name, UnitPrice FROM Track ORDER BY UnitPrice ASC, Name LIMIT 5

question: What is the average track price?
expected_sql: SELECT AVG(UnitPrice) AS AveragePrice FROM Track

question: What is the longest track in milliseconds?
expected_sql: SELECT Name, Milliseconds FROM Track ORDER BY Milliseconds DESC LIMIT 1

question: List 10 tracks with their genre names.
expected_sql: SELECT Track.Name AS TrackName, Genre.Name AS GenreName FROM Track JOIN Genre ON Track.GenreId = Genre.GenreId ORDER BY Track.Name LIMIT 10

question: How many albums does each artist have?
expected_sql: SELECT Artist.Name, COUNT(Album.AlbumId) AS AlbumCount FROM Artist JOIN Album ON Artist.ArtistId = Album.ArtistId GROUP BY Artist.ArtistId, Artist.Name ORDER BY Artist.Name LIMIT 100

question: Which 10 artists have the most albums?
expected_sql: SELECT Artist.Name, COUNT(Album.AlbumId) AS AlbumCount FROM Artist JOIN Album ON Artist.ArtistId = Album.ArtistId GROUP BY Artist.ArtistId, Artist.Name ORDER BY AlbumCount DESC, Artist.Name LIMIT 10

question: How many tracks belong to each genre?
expected_sql: SELECT Genre.Name, COUNT(Track.TrackId) AS TrackCount FROM Genre JOIN Track ON Genre.GenreId = Track.GenreId GROUP BY Genre.GenreId, Genre.Name ORDER BY TrackCount DESC LIMIT 100

question: List the five genres with the most tracks.
expected_sql: SELECT Genre.Name, COUNT(Track.TrackId) AS TrackCount FROM Genre JOIN Track ON Genre.GenreId = Track.GenreId GROUP BY Genre.GenreId, Genre.Name ORDER BY TrackCount DESC, Genre.Name LIMIT 5

question: How many customers are there?
expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS CustomerCount FROM Customer

question: List 10 customers by last name.
expected_sql: SELECT FirstName, LastName FROM Customer ORDER BY LastName, FirstName LIMIT 10

question: How many invoices are there?
expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS InvoiceCount FROM Invoice

question: What is the total invoice revenue?
expected_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(Total), 2) AS TotalRevenue FROM Invoice

question: What is the average invoice total?
expected_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(Total), 2) AS AverageInvoiceTotal FROM Invoice

question: List the five largest invoices.
expected_sql: SELECT InvoiceId, Total FROM Invoice ORDER BY Total DESC, InvoiceId LIMIT 5

question: List 10 invoices with customer names.
expected_sql: SELECT Invoice.InvoiceId, Customer.FirstName, Customer.LastName, Invoice.Total FROM Invoice JOIN Customer ON Invoice.CustomerId = Customer.CustomerId ORDER BY Invoice.InvoiceId LIMIT 10

question: Which five customers have the most invoices?
expected_sql: SELECT Customer.CustomerId, Customer.FirstName, Customer.LastName, COUNT(Invoice.InvoiceId) AS InvoiceCount FROM Customer JOIN Invoice ON Customer.CustomerId = Invoice.CustomerId GROUP BY Customer.CustomerId, Customer.FirstName, Customer.LastName ORDER BY InvoiceCount DESC, Customer.CustomerId LIMIT 5

question: How many employees are there?
expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS EmployeeCount FROM Employee

question: List employees and their job titles.
expected_sql: SELECT FirstName, LastName, Title FROM Employee ORDER BY LastName, FirstName LIMIT 100

question: How many playlists are there?
expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS PlaylistCount FROM Playlist

question: List 10 playlists alphabetically.
expected_sql: SELECT Name FROM Playlist ORDER BY Name LIMIT 10

question: How many tracks are in each playlist?
expected_sql: SELECT Playlist.Name, COUNT(PlaylistTrack.TrackId) AS TrackCount FROM Playlist LEFT JOIN PlaylistTrack ON Playlist.PlaylistId = PlaylistTrack.PlaylistId GROUP BY Playlist.PlaylistId, Playlist.Name ORDER BY Playlist.Name LIMIT 100

question: What is the total duration of all tracks in milliseconds?
expected_sql: SELECT SUM(Milliseconds) AS TotalMilliseconds FROM Track

question: How many tracks are longer than five minutes?
expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS TrackCount FROM Track WHERE Milliseconds > 300000

question: List the 10 largest invoice totals by billing country.
expected_sql: SELECT BillingCountry, ROUND(SUM(Total), 2) AS Revenue FROM Invoice GROUP BY BillingCountry ORDER BY Revenue DESC, BillingCountry LIMIT 10
